name: Federal sentencing by district and offense: individuals sentenced, prison rates and sentence lengths, fiscal years 2021 to 2025
description: The U.S. Sentencing Commission's counts of individuals sentenced in federal court for the nation and each federal judicial district, overall and by type of offense (drug trafficking, firearms, fraud, immigration and 26 others): how many were sentenced, the share sentenced to prison, the average and median sentence in months (prison plus alternative confinement, probation as zero), and the shares convicted by guilty plea and after trial. Built from the Commission's public datafiles without individual identifiers, reduced to cell counts; each district and offense listed had 10 or more individuals in the latest year.
citeAs: Probative Growth. (2026). Federal sentencing by district and offense: individuals sentenced, prison rates and sentence lengths, fiscal years 2021 to 2025 (Version 1.0.1) [Data set]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24022955

distribution.name: federal-sentencing.csv
distribution.description: Every record, one row each (RFC 4180, UTF-8). Columns are described in README.txt.

distribution.name: federal-sentencing.json
distribution.description: Every record with its full sources, under a meta envelope (credit line, DOI, license).

recordSet.name: federal-sentencing
recordSet.description: The records of Federal sentencing by district and offense: individuals sentenced, prison rates and sentence lengths, fiscal years 2021 to 2025, one per CSV row.

field.name: id
field.description: Stable record id (never reused)

field.name: jurisdiction
field.description: Two-letter state or territory code of the district, or US

field.name: level
field.description: us or district

field.name: scope
field.description: all (every offense type) or offense (one primary offense type)

field.name: area
field.description: US, or the district's USSC code

field.name: areaName
field.description: United States or the district's name

field.name: stateName
field.description: State or territory name (United States for the nation)

field.name: districtCode
field.description: The Commission's two-digit district code (US for the nation)

field.name: districtName
field.description: Name of the federal judicial district (All districts for the nation)

field.name: offense
field.description: The Commission's primary offense type code 1-30 (all for all offenses)

field.name: offenseName
field.description: Primary offense type (All offenses for all offenses)

field.name: status
field.description: P: the Commission's own datafile

field.name: text
field.description: The record in one plain-English sentence

field.name: value
field.description: Individuals sentenced in the latest fiscal year (the same as sentenced)

field.name: unit
field.description: Unit of value

field.name: year
field.description: Latest fiscal year in the record (October to September)

field.name: window
field.description: Fiscal years covered

field.name: sentenced
field.description: Individuals sentenced in the latest fiscal year (felonies and Class A misdemeanors the Commission received documents for)

field.name: prison_pct
field.description: Percent sentenced to prison, alone or with confinement conditions

field.name: probation_pct
field.description: Percent sentenced to probation, alone or with confinement conditions

field.name: fine_only_pct
field.description: Percent with no prison or probation (fine only)

field.name: mean_months
field.description: Average sentence in months (prison plus months of alternative confinement), probation counted as 0 months and sentences of 470 months or more, including life, as 470, per the Commission's tables

field.name: median_months
field.description: Median sentence in months, counted the same way

field.name: plea_pct
field.description: Percent convicted by guilty plea

field.name: trial_pct
field.description: Percent convicted after a trial

field.name: effectiveFrom
field.description: First day of the latest fiscal year (October 1)

field.name: effectiveTo
field.description: Last day of the latest fiscal year (September 30)

field.name: lastChecked
field.description: Date the files were last re-read from the Commission

field.name: sourceLabels
field.description: Sources, separated by " | "

field.name: sourceUrls
field.description: Source URLs, in the same order

field.name: confidence
field.description: high, medium or low: computed from status, a second check, age against the refresh cadence and sampling error (rule: /data/#confidence)

field.name: confidenceBasis
field.description: The reasons for the confidence level, in a short phrase
